services.name: New water well drilling
services.blurb: Sited, drilled, cased and tested, with a written drill log of every foot down.

services.name: Well deepening
services.blurb: When the water table drops below your pump, we go deeper instead of starting over.

services.name: Well pump replacement
services.blurb: Old pump pulled, new one sized to your depth and set below the summer water level.

services.name: Well pump repair
services.blurb: Motor, wiring or control box tested at the wellhead so you only pay for what failed.

services.name: Pressure tank service
services.blurb: Waterlogged tank or a pump that clicks on and off, set back to steady pressure.

services.name: Water level and yield test
services.blurb: We measure how far down your water sits and how many gallons a minute it gives.

services.name: Water testing
services.blurb: Lab test for nitrates, fluoride, arsenic and bacteria, explained line by line.

services.name: Well abandonment
services.blurb: Old or dry wells plugged and sealed to state rules so nothing drains into the aquifer.

services.name: No-water emergency calls
services.blurb: Taps dry at home? A phone line answered after hours and a truck sent out.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our old well near Shallowater started pulling air every July. Coy measured the water level, showed us it had dropped about forty feet since the pump went in, and deepened it instead of drilling a new hole. Two summers now, no sputtering.
reviews.name: Darla M.

reviews.text: They handed me the drill log the day they finished: where they hit caliche, where the sand started, where the water came in. I've owned three wells and never once got that.
reviews.name: Ernesto V.

reviews.text: Pump quit on a Sunday night with a house full of kids. They called back in ten minutes and had the control box swapped before breakfast.
reviews.name: Kimber L.

reviews.text: We bought a place outside Slaton and had no idea what was under it. The yield test told us what the well can actually do, so we sized the garden and the stock tank around it instead of guessing.
reviews.name: Trent O.

reviews.text: Clear about the price before the rig moved. The pump was set lower than the last one and they explained why, with the numbers written on the invoice.
reviews.name: Marisa C.

reviews.text: Fluoride came back high on the test and they didn't try to sell me anything that day. Just walked me through the results and what our options were.
reviews.name: Glenn P.

proof.guarantee: Every pump we set is covered for 3 years, parts and labor, and your drill log is yours in writing.
